text: In this state, functional IQ drops substantially. More importantly, this state floods the Nucleus Accumbens with the catecholamines that transcribe new DeltaFosB proteins (the "armor"). The Takeaway: If you attempt to process trauma while living above this red line, you are not de-armoring; you are actively re-enforcing the armor.
section: Part 1 A: The Metabolic Red Line
reader: someone deciding whether to do trauma work today, who needs to know that processing while dysregulated makes things worse

sentences.s: In this state, functional IQ drops substantially.
More importantly, this state floods the Nucleus Accumbens with the catecholamines that transcribe new DeltaFosB proteins (the "armor").
sentences.payoff: It gives the reader the reason the red line matters more than discomfort: above it they are not just uncomfortable, they are laying down more of the protein the rest of the protocol is trying to clear.
sentences.follows: "More importantly" turns on the IQ drop before it: that was the cost to thinking, this is the cost to the hardware, and the hardware is what the article is about.

sentences.s: The Takeaway: If you attempt to process trauma while living above this red line, you are not de-armoring; you are actively re-enforcing the armor.

checked.point: An exact cocktail of catecholamines transcribes new DeltaFosB
checked.found: Chronic stress does drive DeltaFosB up in the nucleus accumbens -- restraint, unpredictable and social defeat stress all do it (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4380559). No work identifies a specific catecholamine mixture that does the transcribing.
checked.still_needed: yes: the induction-by-stress point holds and is the reason the sentence is here; only the claimed precision goes

placement: Second paragraph of section A, between the IQ drop and The Takeaway, which tells the reader what to do about it. The sentence has to come before The Takeaway or the instruction has no reason.
